This minimal mechanical placement case is not fertility, hardness or viability certification; unsupported substrate remains unknown. Preserve deposit matter. Exact root escrow and paid work persist; conflicts pause before further cost. Cancel/death releases surviving unplanted root on the actual ground once. Completed placement retains one planted-unverified specimen and ages normally. No growth, harvest, reward, free material, maintenance or automatic mastery.
